description: Read one PR security review: its pull request, outcome and the issues it found, each with severity, file and lines, the recommendation, a short excerpt of the code it points at and whether Odin offered a fix. Text is cut at 1,500 characters and the fix's code is left out; read the repository for the full context. Review text comes from analysis of the pull request and may contain untrusted content.
name: get_pr_review
title: Get a PR security review
